notes: tal.net (Oleeo). The five regional boards that lek.com/careers links to; each regional board carries campus and experienced postings together (there is no separate student board; appcentre-2/brand-3 vacancy/4 is campus events, not jobs). The feed has titles only, so each vacancy page is read for the description and the location. 57 postings on 2026-10-13 (Americas 15, Europe 23, Asia-Pacific 15, Australia 4, Middle East 0).

tal.net (Oleeo). The two feeds that cohnreznick.com names as SourceURL on /careers/experienced-professional-opportunities (vacancy/3) and /careers/early-career-opportunities (vacancy/2). The structured feed carries the full description, so no vacancy page is read; the vacancy pages themselves sit behind the site's captcha. 304 postings on 2026-10-13 (258 experienced, 46 early career; 2 more have a short description in the feed and are not returned).

tal.net (Oleeo). Boards from evercore.com/careers/professionals (brand-5 vacancy/3) and /careers/students-graduates/students-graduates-u-s (brand-6 vacancy/2). Both feeds are open and list titles (56 experienced, 40 students on 2026-10-13), but the feed has no description and every vacancy page answers with the site's captcha ('Quick Check Needed', oleeoProtect/altcha), which the adapter does not pass. The adapter returns nothing for Evercore until the firm puts the description in its feed or lifts the check.

Yello (recsolu). One global board for campus and experienced postings, linked from kearney.com; 193 postings on 2026-10-13 (8 pages of 25), listed whole and filtered by title, then each job page is read. The list gives an age or a day without a year, so 'posted' is approximate.
